title: Ciel the Commander
statementMd:
Now Fox Ciel becomes a commander of Tree Land. Tree Land, like its name said, has $*n*$ cities connected by $*n* - 1$ undirected roads, and for any two cities there always exists a path between them.

Fox Ciel needs to assign an officer to each city. Each officer has a rank — a letter from '`A`' to '`Z`'. So there will be 26 different ranks, and '`A`' is the topmost, so '`Z`' is the bottommost.

There are enough officers of each rank. But there is a special rule must obey: if $*x*$ and $*y*$ are two distinct cities and their officers have the same rank, then on the simple path between $*x*$ and $*y*$ there must be a city $*z*$ that has an officer with higher rank. The rule guarantee that a communications between same rank officers will be monitored by higher rank officer.

Help Ciel to make a valid plan, and if it's impossible, output "`Impossible!`".

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of cities in Tree Land.

Each of the following $*n* - 1$ lines contains two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*, *a* ≠ *b*$) — they mean that there will be an undirected road between $*a*$ and $*b*$. Consider all the cities are numbered from 1 to $*n*$.

It guaranteed that the given graph will be a tree.

## Output

If there is a valid plane, output $*n*$ space-separated characters in a line — $*i*$-th character is the rank of officer in the city with number $*i*$.

Otherwise output "`Impossible!`".

## Note

In the first example, for any two officers of rank '`B`', an officer with rank '`A`' will be on the path between them. So it is a valid solution.
statementZhMd:
如今，Fox Ciel 成为了树之国的指挥官。顾名思义，树之国有 $*n*$ 座城市，由 $*n* - 1$ 条无向道路连接，并且任意两座城市之间都存在一条路径。

Fox Ciel 需要为每座城市分配一名军官。每名军官都有一个等级——从 '`A`' 到 '`Z`' 的一个字母。因此，一共有 26 种不同的等级，其中 '`A`' 最高，'`Z`' 最低。

每种等级的军官数量都足够。但必须遵守一条特殊规定：如果 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 是两座不同的城市，且它们的军官等级相同，那么在 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 之间的简单路径上，必须存在一座城市 $*z*$，其军官等级更高。该规定保证了相同等级军官之间的通信会受到更高等级军官的监视。

请帮助 Ciel 制定一个合法方案；如果无法做到，请输出“`Impossible!`”。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——树之国中的城市数量。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*$，$*a* ≠ *b*$），表示在城市 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 之间有一条无向道路。城市编号为 1 到 $*n*$。

保证给出的图是一棵树。

## 输出格式

如果存在合法方案，输出一行由 $*n*$ 个字符组成、以空格分隔的字符串——第 $*i*$ 个字符表示编号为 $*i*$ 的城市中军官的等级。

否则输出“`Impossible!`”。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，对于任意两名等级为 '`B`' 的军官，它们之间的路径上都会有一名等级为 '`A`' 的军官。因此，这是一个合法方案。
